caption:
The three-paragraph apology

Cella wrote three paragraphs to say five words.

An apology lands best when it names what happened and stops, since extra explanation tends to sound like a defense.

For the friend who apologizes in one line.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left with typing dots above it, facing a counter that reads 148 words. Each time it narrows its eyes the counter drops: 96, 41, 12, 5. Then the dots vanish and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me writing a three paragraph apology, to: sent: I was wrong. I'm sorry.
